answer: A sparrow-sized honest newcomer can post a small bond and build reputation, while a relic account that recycles identities loses its entire stake. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a copper-denominated bond that is slashed on proven duplicate-identity fraud, making mass fake accounts capital-expensive. Attackers must burn real capital per sybil, so forging thousands of identities costs more than the rewards they could extract. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
